rows.surface: Sensor/display behavior checks and constructor readiness scheduling
rows.mechanism: Install hook interception synchronously. Defer readiness, acceptance and sentinel registration onto the main queue after the dylib initializer returns. Construct CoreMotion/UIKit verification objects only in the behavior verifier, before a readiness receipt; recompute rather than return cached success. Network authorization still requires the unchanged signed lease and all existing checks.
rows.verification: An actual Facebook clone hit iOS process-launch watchdog after sensor initialization under the dyld initializer lock. Checkpoints stopped after battery and the stackshot showed the main thread waiting with UIKit applicationSupportClient. Failing-first native fixture reproduces premature hardware construction. Actual methods pass with normal, mismatched-display and failed-hook providers. Offline device retry reaches subsequent hook installers and storage probes. Separate Facebook app execution later terminates in its own framework; this change does not claim stable Facebook launch.
rows.fix: Constructor hang fixed. Facebook admission remains inactive and defaults-wire remains false. Actual production Reddit UI and online/MDM acceptance still require their own device tests.

evidence.detail: Synchronous installation without UIKit/CoreMotion object creation; actual deferred verifier.

Actual production method fixture rejects pre-start hardware access and stale/failed behavior.

rows.surface: Profile control-directory parents created by root daemon
rows.mechanism: Traverse the exact OS-issued clone home with openat and O_NOFOLLOW. Provision every Library/Application Support/RedditBox component for the mobile owner, repair only root-owned legacy components, reject foreign ownership/symlinks, and propagate fchown/fchmod failures. Preserve existing app-owned parent modes.
rows.verification: Physical clone A had root-owned mode-0700 Application Support, preventing all four private group directories. Actual daemon sync repaired both disposable clone parents to mobile and all four own-group marker checks then passed. Host test executes the actual no-follow helper: 22 assertions covering fresh/existing paths, owner rejection, symlink/regular-file denial, injected chmod failure and preservation of existing parent modes. This fixes own access only: actual cross-clone file reads still succeed on this phone and remain an independent release-blocking gap.
rows.fix: Own-parent ownership fixed; do not equate successful own I/O with enforced sandbox isolation.
